sections.text:
-Decreases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 1000. Success value 100. 5x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Constriction. The next Ability used will change from targeting all to a single target (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 5 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 10 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Fire Qualia (increases all stats by 100%, increases fire elemental attack by 10, increases fire elemental defense by 150, and nullifies Scorching and Blind) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000
Fire and Water Defense from Unison Damage +700
